Name: Quaint Living - Rose Garden
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center]This mod adds 9 roses from Quaint Living - Flower Garden to the game sold by Pierre. 

Please do not install this mod if you already have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15107/]Quaint Living - Flower Garden.
[/url]

[img=center]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15159/15159-1674386063-1097810423.png[/img]


Happy gardening![/center]
[line][b]
List of flowers added:[/b][line]

Spring:
[spoiler]
* Bluemire Belle Rose (Marnie 2H)
* Pomponella Rose (Clint 8H)
* Queen of Bourbons Rose (Year 3)
* Snowball Rose
[/spoiler]

Summer:
[spoiler]
* Pink Damask Rose 
* Queen of Bourbons Rose (Year 3)
* Rainbow Sorbet Rose (Year 2)
* Red Imperial Rose (Year 3)
[/spoiler]

Fall:
[spoiler]
* Green Rose (Leah 4H)
* Osiria Rose (Year 3)
* Red Imperial Rose (Year 3)
[/spoiler]
[b]
[line]
Notes:[/b][line]
* This mod is intended for those who don't wish to install Quaint Living - Flower Garden but want the roses.
* Most of the roses are intentionally made to be only available in year 2 and 3. If you want to unlock them earlier, feel free to edit the crop.json inside each of the roses folders for your personal use.
* The name of most of the flowers included in this mod are true to their real-life counterpart, while the remaining few are modified for compatibility with other mods, or simply to make the names fit with the Stardew Valley vibe in general. [b]
[/b]
